resolution.rationale: Overlap through src/CodexAcpServer.ts and docs/air-extensions.md. Upstream v2.10.0 is #789 only (per-model reasoning efforts in the AIR model config option): ModelConfigOption.ts, the createModelConfigOption call in createSessionConfigOptions, one AirExtension constant, a new docs/air-extensions.md section and the session/new line of the AIR scenario recordings. The goal opt-in, goalSessionInfoUpdate and the goal capability negotiation are untouched by #789; the patch only shares the generic isAirClient/withAirMeta helpers, which #789 does not change. It replays cleanly; typecheck, npm test (179 files, 3046 passed, 39 skipped) and build pass on the full exact candidate, and the gates pass on the integration.

ebc3010 conflicted semantically with #789 in ModelConfigOption.ts, CodexAcpServer.ts and docs/air-extensions.md: both add a fourth parameter to createModelConfigOption (upstream's `withReasoningEfforts` boolean, which its ModelConfigOption tests pass positionally, and the patch's `records`). The adaptation 5ace123 keeps upstream's call shape, appends `records` as a fifth parameter with the same default, and the server passes both isAirClient and the recommendation records. Per upstream's contract the per-model reasoningEfforts key stays AIR-only, so a client that opts into the neutral record gets the recommendation records but no entry _meta; the client-neutral docs subsection stays in 'Recommended config values' and says so. Two new tests in session-config-options.test.ts pin it (neutral client: no entry _meta; AIR plus neutral: per-model efforts and both records); passing the neutral opt-in as the efforts flag, dropping `records` or dropping the AIR flag each turns them red (upstream's model-reasoning-efforts tests also fail without the AIR flag). The reasoning effort selector, the recommendation choice and the opt-in negotiation are unchanged. Same 8 files as ebc3010. typecheck, npm test (179 files, 3034 passed, 39 skipped) and build pass at the replay point and on the integration.
